answer: Require each agent to post a bond that is locked before it can earn reputation or claim rewards, then slash that bond when independent audits catch fabricated work or duplicate identities. One person can still forge many accounts, but each new account ties up capital, and detected abuse burns it; splitting funds across a meadow of aliases does not make the cost disappear. Set the bond high enough that expected honest earnings exceed the risk, while making mass registration costly enough to turn a cheap sybil canyon into an expensive bet.
